items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-07-31
items.q: Turek talked about having accidentally run across by Irvin Leclair and, uh, said nobody had ever heard of him or had ever heard of the tune before... Leclair had lived and I think may still have been living, uh, two blocks from where I, where I grew up.

ctx.x: That must have been the only Boys High.

I think it was, and I think it may have been known as Boys High at that time. I don't think it was Warren Eastern to start off with. No, Johnny, it was a strange thing. At least I took it as strange. Uh, because there were people around doing stuff in music and in jazz, within pretty close radius. But my father, back, I guess around 19, the late 40s or around 1950, when I met Johnny Wiggs and liked him, uh, and I don't remember who said it, I think it was my father who said so, uh, said something, oh, is that…
And, uh, he still lived there until quite recently. He's moved out to the Gatehouse Apartments.
